channel.title: Acme: Fantasy Sports Experts
channel.description: News about fantasy sports experts, analysts, shows and outlets.

item.title: Jeff Mans addresses his continuing SiriusXM absence without explaining it
item.description: In the October 28 episode of One MANS Opinion, Mans briefly acknowledges that he has been absent from his SiriusXM show and points listeners to other ways to get his fantasy-football work. He does not state why he is away or whether he will return.

item.title: Jeff Mans surfaces on Fantasy Sports Daily amid unexplained SiriusXM absence
item.description: Jeff Mans hosted a special Oct. 27 edition of Fantasy Sports Daily while absent from his normal SiriusXM Fantasy Sports Radio slot. SiriusXM still lists Elite Sports with Mans on its schedule, and no departure has been announced.

item.title: Matthew Berry launches daily Pregame show on Roku
item.description: Roku launched Pregame with Matthew Berry, a two-hour weekday sports and fantasy show produced by Fantasy Life. The series began Sept. 28 on the Roku Sports Channel, giving Berry a new daily television home after leaving NBC earlier in 2026.
